name: blog-content
title: Blog Content Loader
description: Typed post collection from MDX files: validated front matter, authors and categories, drafts and scheduled posts hidden, headings and reading time, and the post elements in the project's design system
proof: installs alone on Next 16; post elements equal 1.0.0's; 3 sample brands, light and dark, at 390/768/1280 px in two host apps; axe clean; no leak; front matter, refusals, paging tested; mutants caught
postMessage: Needs @mdx-js/mdx, yaml and zod. Posts go in content/blog/; see src/utils/blog-content/README.md for the format and the Next link wiring.
